opportunities.name: Plan a trip stopover: city facts + cheapest top hotel + note
opportunities.description: For a given stopover city and date, look up the city on Wikipedia (population, main landmark), search Booking.com for a one-night stay for 2 adults, take the top-listed hotel and price, and save a note 'Stopover {city} {date}: {hotel} €{price}. See {landmark} (pop {population})'.
steps: Open Wikipedia and search for {city}; open the city article
Read the population and a notable landmark
Open Booking.com and enter {city} as the destination, picking the first suggestion
Open the date picker and select check-in {date} and check-out {date}+1 night
Click Search
Read the name and nightly price of the top result
Open Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Stopover {city} {date}: {hotel} €{price}. See {landmark} (pop {population})'
Save the note

instances.values: Dijon, Nov 21 → Aparthotel Adagio Access Dijon République €69, historical centre, pop 161,830
Reims, Dec 19 → Best Western Premier Hotel de la Paix €204, Reims Cathedral, pop 177,674
Annecy, Feb 13 → Moxy Annecy €120, Lake Annecy, pop 132,117

opportunities.name: Prepare a family call email with local time and weather
opportunities.description: For a relative living in {city}, look up the current local time and offset from Lille on timeanddate, get the 10-day forecast for the call day on weather.com, and draft an email to family@example.com with the subject 'Call with {relative} on {day}' and a body giving the time and forecast.
steps: Open timeanddate.com and search {city} in the world clock search
Read the current local time, time zone and offset from Lille
Open weather.com, click the location selector and search for {city}; pick the correct match
Open the 10 Day tab and read the forecast for {day} (conditions, high/low, chance of rain)
Open New message, set To = family@example.com
Set Subject = 'Call with {relative} on {day}'
Write the body 'Calling {relative} on {day}. It is {time} {tz} in {city} now ({offset} Lille), forecast there: {conditions} {day}, high {high}, low {low}, {rain}% chance of rain.'
Send (or discard) the draft

instances.values: Montreal, Grandma Rose, Sunday (13:58 EDT, 6h behind, high 49°F low 39°F, 4% rain)
Sydney, Uncle Ben, Saturday (05:02 AEDT, 9h ahead, high 68°F low 58°F, 24% rain)
Singapore, Aunt Mei, Friday (02:09 SGT, 6h ahead, PM showers, high 91°F low 79°F, 44% rain)

opportunities.name: Dinner plan: eat out vs. cook note
opportunities.description: For a given cuisine and London area, find the top OpenTable restaurant (rating, price band, area) and the top Allrecipes recipe for a matching dish (total time), then save a note 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({time})'.
steps: Open OpenTable (London, today, 20:00, 2 people) and type '{cuisine} {area}' in the search box; choose the 'Search: ...' suggestion
Read the name, rating, price band and area of the first result
Open Allrecipes and search for {dish}
Open the first result and read its total time
Open Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({time})'
Save the note

instances.values: Italian Islington → Terra Rossa - Angel (4.7, £26 to £40); lasagna → Creamy Chicken Lasagna (1 hr 30 mins)
Thai Soho → Thai Tho - Soho (4.3, £26 to £40); pad thai → Pad Thai (45 mins)
Indian Shoreditch → SPICE SLICE Shoreditch (1.3, £25 and under); chicken tikka masala → Chicken Tikka Masala (2 hrs 20 mins)
